source_evidence: Under most annuity contracts, you can choose to have your income payments last for a period that you set (such as 20 years) or for an indefinite period (such as your lifetime or the lifetime of your spouse).
question: Misconception: Variable annuity payments always last for life once I start receiving them.
answer: Not necessarily. The payment period depends on the option selected: payments may last for a set term, such as 20 years, or continue for an indefinite period, such as your lifetime. Annuitization can help protect against outliving your assets when you choose a lifetime payment option.
